title: Working title
logline: An explorer seeks a way out before a rising underground stream cuts off the return.

scenes.action: Explorer enters an uneven limestone chamber and stops at a fork.
scenes.framing: Vertical wide shot; full figure occupies a small part of the lower third.
scenes.lighting: Controlled headlamp beam with faint warm bounce; retain shadow detail.

camera.intent: Establish the explorer's scale and route into the cave.
camera.movement: Slow push-in along the entrance axis; stop before the fork.
camera.lens_intent: Moderate perspective; preserve body proportions and cave depth.

cinematography.transition_reason: Cut to the fork when the headlamp reaches it.

rig.profile: Adult biped with independent root, gaze, foot, and hand controls.

beats.action: Walk toward the fork and decelerate.
beats.pose_out: Upper body settles over the leading foot.
beats.anticipation: Short weight shift before the final step.
beats.weight_intent: Transfer weight into the planted leading foot.

root_motion.intent: Advance along the entry path toward the fork.

support.weight_transfer: Left foot supports as right foot clears the ground.

beats.action: Stop and hold at the fork.
beats.pose_in: Upper body settling from the final step.
beats.pose_out: Balanced standing pose, ready to inspect the route.
beats.weight_intent: Distribute weight over both planted feet.

support.weight_transfer: Settle evenly without sliding either foot.

continuity.incoming: Opening shot; start already oriented toward the cave interior.
continuity.outgoing: End balanced and looking screen-right for shot-02.

scenes.action: A fresh rope end hangs above the rising waterline; explorer notices it.
scenes.camera: Short motivated pan from the explorer's gaze to the rope.
scenes.lighting: Headlamp picks out the rope while soft fill preserves the rock surface.

scenes.purpose: End on a choice and unresolved danger.
scenes.action: Explorer turns toward a narrow ledge as water reaches the trail marker.
scenes.framing: Medium profile with the ledge and waterline both legible.
scenes.camera: Locked frame; let the actor's turn carry the beat.
scenes.lighting: Headlamp tracks the ledge; no decorative emissive accents.
